report.explanation: Alert shows four checkout calls all HTTP 200 with durations 344/62/63/78 ms; only the first is elevated. Traces show all spans ok with no errors, logs show no error levels, and metrics show zero 502s on /v1/checkout. No evidence supports any taxonomy cause; the single 344 ms sample is insufficient to establish downstream latency.
